About

About the repository

Godfrey Okoye University Institutional Repository

Overview

GOREPO is the institutional research repository of Godfrey Okoye University, Enugu, Nigeria. It provides open access to the scholarly and research output of the university community — including doctoral theses, master's dissertations, peer-reviewed journal articles, books, book chapters, conference papers, and technical reports.

Scope

The repository accepts works produced by members of the Godfrey Okoye University community — students, academic staff, and researchers — across all faculties and departments. Works must be finalized and, where applicable, have received institutional approval prior to deposit. The repository covers all academic disciplines represented at the university.

Open access statement

Godfrey Okoye University is committed to open access to knowledge. All items deposited in the repository are made freely available to the global research community without embargo, in line with the Budapest Open Access Initiative. Authors retain copyright over their works; the university holds a non-exclusive licence to preserve and distribute them.

Metadata standards

All items are described using Dublin Core metadata elements and are harvestable via the OAI-PMH 2.0 protocol. Subject classifications follow the Library of Congress Classification system.

  • OAI-PMH base URL: https://eprints.gouni.edu.ng/api/oai
  • Atom feed: https://eprints.gouni.edu.ng/api/feed/atom
  • RSS feed: https://eprints.gouni.edu.ng/api/feed/rss

Contact

For enquiries about depositing, accessing, or withdrawing items, please contact the repository administrator.

Email: eprints@gouni.edu.ng

Address: Library Services, Godfrey Okoye University, Thinkers Corner, Enugu, Nigeria
